inputs.work: `wordCount` in src/text.ts counts empty strings between separators as words: "one   two" gives 4. Fix it so any run of whitespace (spaces, tabs, newlines), including leading and trailing whitespace, separates words: "  one   two\tthree\n" is 3 and a string of only whitespace is 0. Add regression tests.
inputs.implementation_plan:
1. Change `wordCount` in src/text.ts to split on runs of whitespace and ignore empty pieces.
2. Add regression tests in src/text.test.ts for repeated spaces, tabs, newlines, leading and trailing whitespace, and whitespace-only input.
inputs.implementation_summary: Fixed `wordCount` in src/text.ts so runs of whitespace, tabs, newlines and leading or trailing whitespace no longer produce empty words, and added regression tests for each of those cases. I ran the full suite and it passes, the new tests cover the behaviour and its edge cases, and the change is complete and verified; nothing else was touched.
